# core.CCOutput { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput }

```python
core.CCOutput(
    time,
    state_variables,
    state_variable_names,
    diagnostic_variables,
    solution,
    run_name,
)
```

Container for the results of one call to ``CCModel.integrate()``.

``CCOutput`` carries the full trajectory produced by the solver and
exposes output-focused operations (noise addition, pyleoclim export,
time resampling).  Keeping these on the output rather than on the model
means a single model instance can produce multiple independent outputs
without them overwriting each other.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

<code>[**model_time**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray of float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Raw time axis as returned by the solver.  Never modified after construction; inspect this to understand the solver's actual grid.

<code>[**time**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray of float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   User-facing time axis.  Starts equal to ``model_time``; replaced by ``reframe_time_axis`` when a different grid is requested. ``state_variables`` is always aligned to ``time``.

<code>[**state_variables**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [structured ndarray]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Named state variable arrays, indexed by variable name.

<code>[**state_variable_names**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [list of str]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Ordered list of state variable names.

<code>[**diagnostic_variables**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [dict of str → ndarray]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Named diagnostic arrays.

<code>[**solution**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[object](`object`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Raw solver output (retained for dense-output resampling via ``reframe_time_axis``).

<code>[**run_name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Label for this integration run.

### add_noise { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.add_noise }

```python
core.CCOutput.add_noise(var_name, noise_ts)
```

Add externally provided noise to an output variable.

The unmodified values are saved on the first call so that
``remove_noise`` can restore the clean series.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**var_name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Name of a state or diagnostic variable.

<code>[**noise_ts**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Noise series with the same shape as the target variable.

### get_series_by_name { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.get_series_by_name }

```python
core.CCOutput.get_series_by_name(var_name)
```

Return a variable's array and its storage location.

State variables live in a structured numpy array; diagnostic
variables live in a dict.  Returning the location string lets
callers that write back (e.g. ``add_noise``) know which container
to update.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**values**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray of float]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   

<code>[**location**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [{\'state\', \'diagnostic\'}]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   

### reframe_time_axis { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.reframe_time_axis }

```python
core.CCOutput.reframe_time_axis(t_eval)
```

Resample state variables onto a new time axis.

Uses the dense output from ``solve_ivp`` when available (accurate
polynomial interpolation); falls back to linear interpolation for
fixed-step solvers.

After this call, ``time`` is replaced by ``t_eval`` and
``state_variables`` is replaced by the interpolated values.
``model_time`` is never modified and always reflects the solver's
original grid.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**t_eval**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Target time axis.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**reframed**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [structured ndarray or ndarray]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Resampled state variables on ``t_eval``.

### remove_noise { #climatecritters.core.CCOutput.remove_noise }

```python
core.CCOutput.remove_noise(var_name)
```

Restore a variable to its pre-noise values.

Reverses ``add_noise`` by replacing the noisy array with the
clean copy saved on the first ``add_noise`` call.
